title: Structure Set
description: Defines a structure set that controls the placement and distribution of structures in the world.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this structure set definition.

minecraft:structure_set.title: Structure Set Definition
minecraft:structure_set.description:
The structure set definition.

Properties:
• description (object)
• placement ({ type, salt, separation, ... })
• structures

description.title: Description
description.description:
The description block containing the structure set identifier.

Properties:
• identifier (string)

placement.title: Placement
placement.description:
Defines how structures in this set are placed in the world.

Properties:
• type (string)
• salt (int)
• separation (int) = 8
• spacing (int) = 34
• spread_type (string) = linear

type.title: Type
type.description: The placement algorithm type. Valid values: 'minecraft:random_spread', 'minecraft:concentric_rings'.

salt.title: Salt
salt.description: A seed modifier for randomization. Each structure set should use a unique salt.

separation.title: Separation
separation.description: Minimum distance in chunks between structure placements.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Average distance in chunks between structure placements. Must be greater than separation.

spread_type.title: Spread Type
spread_type.description: How structures spread within the grid. Valid values: 'linear', 'triangular'.

defaultSnippets.label: Placement
defaultSnippets.description: Defines how structures in this set are placed in the world.

structures.title: Structures
structures.description:
Array of structures in this set with their relative weights.

Properties:
• structure (string)
• weight (int)

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: Identifier of the Jigsaw Structure Set.

weight.title: weight
weight.description: Weight of the Jigsaw Structure in the set. Higher weights are more likely to be selected.
